identitySignals: Organization's own website (helpeveryonereachone.com) identifies the HERO program as 'Help Everyone Reach One', serving Oakland and other East Bay communities

Website describes school-site sports, student leadership, extracurricular and academic support programs, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' and 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
Website carries an endorsement from a former Oakland Unified superintendent about the HERO program at school sites
research.notes: Could not confirm in a public registry: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer returned no organization named 'Help Everyone Reach One', and no contact details, legal name or EIN appear on the site. Search budget was exhausted, so CA Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked. Needs human verification before publishing.

profile.summary: HERO (Help Everyone Reach One) provides programs to schools in the Bay Area, including structured recess, sports and physical activity, student leadership, extracurricular activities and academic support.

sources.title: Help Everyone Reach One - Empowering Future Leaders through Games & Activities
